description: Explicit repository-source to production-destination allowlist for the deterministic NullOne release CLI. Repository engineering only; MERGE != DEPLOY.

mappings.description: Deterministic workflow scripts (Morning, Analytics, Story, Breaking, publish, scheduler authority).

notes: Secret-bearing destinations (secret files, OAuth/session/auth state, Telegram owner data, presigned-URL artifacts, ledgers, receipts, caches) are excluded via the explicit forbidden_prod_prefixes above — never via filename-substring matching, because allowlisted code filenames legitimately contain substrings like 'auth' (authority), 'secret' (secret_provider boundary), or 'session' (supersession).
Deploy-state content is independently guarded against secret values by the release tool.

V1 scope is the proven production workspace root only (nullone update). external_controlled_components are repository-only classifications: if a reviewed release range touches them, the plan reports EXTERNAL_COMPONENT_CHANGES and ordinary update fails closed with CONTROLLED_COMPONENT_DEPLOY_REQUIRED instead of partially deploying. Future V2 may add reviewed multi-root support; guessed multi-root paths are forbidden.

Restart semantics: workspace mappings declare restart_required=false (read fresh on next invocation; undeclared defaults conservative-true). plugins/nullone-final-publish/** is an externally-controlled component with restart_required=true (Gateway activation is a controlled step; the tool never restarts anything). The plan reports RESTART_REQUIRED=YES when a changed workspace file needs it or when a release range touches a restart-required external component.

external_controlled_components.description: Gateway plugin installation dir is a separate, unproven filesystem root (NOT the workspace root). Deployed only via a controlled external process; the V1 tool never copies these files.
Live agent-definition destination is not proven to be under the same production workspace root. Deployed only via a controlled external process; the V1 tool never copies these files.
